column1: # Well-known MCP servers, the fixed list mcp_known sends (TELEMETRY.md), in the order the report
# lists them. A server's label, its name in the config, is lowercased and cut to the part after the
# last / (so @scope/name gives name). Spaces, dots and underscores become -, and mcp- and server- come
# off the front and -mcp and -server off the end, as often as they appear. When nothing is left, as
# with @playwright/mcp, the part before the / is used. What remains must equal an id or one of its
# aliases. Any other label only adds one to mcp_other, and is never sent. gird.ai keeps the same list
# and drops any other id, so change both together. One line each, tab separated. After editing, run:
#   id       the server's id: lowercase letters, digits and -
#   aliases  other labels that mean it, separated by ,, or - for none
